text:
morgan: Kicking off onboarding for lon2 GPU region — need new AWS account/project + VPC scaffold and reserved GPU quota for 8 H100s (burst to 12). Target live next Tue. Items: billing acct link, IAM roles, subnet plan, NAT, VPC Flow Logs to central logging, KMS key, service account rotation, GPU quotas, firewall rules, peering to prod-core, cost tags. Who can pick up the handoff?

ravi: I can take account/project + VPC template. Clarify: lon2 = AWS (eu-west-3) right?

morgan: yes AWS eu-west-3. billing code RD-LLM-ENG-027. Follow standard tags: cost-center, environment, owner, team.

lia: Quick quota note — for H100s we'll need to open a Service Quotas request and escalate with our TAM. Last time it took ~48–72h if we loop TAM in. Recommend opening today.

ravi: Adding checklist notes. I'll reuse the vpc-scaffold module and parameterize for this account. Proposed subnets: private-a 10.120.0.0/20, private-b 10.120.16.0/20, mgmt 10.120.32.0/24. AZs: eu-west-3a/b/c. NAT in each AZ.

sam: Ops concern: large model weights egress — mirror model artifacts to regional S3 and pull locally during node bootstrap. Also add lifecycle rule to keep last 3 AMIs for infer runtime.

helen: KMS: use customer-managed key in org KMS for EBS/encryption. infra-bot, can you create key request and attach policy for redwood-inference-service?

infra-bot: KMS key request submitted: request-4829. Estimated provision time ~24h.

ravi: Quick snippet for tags & IAM we'll attach to the account: ```tags: {"cost-center":"RD-LLM-ENG-027","env":"prod","owner":"morgan"} iam_roles: ["inference-runner","node-operator","logging-writer"]```

jack: Networking: need peering/TGW path to prod-core-vpc (10.0.0.0/16). Confirm no CIDR overlap. Add route table entries for peering and enable VPC Flow Logs -> central-log-acc. Also ensure NACLs allow ephemeral ports for training agent.

amelia: Security checklist: lock control-plane SGs to corp VPN + bastion only. No public SSH on nodes. Use SSM Session Manager for admin access and rotate instance profile keys on schedule.

morgan: Cost estimate: reserved 8x H100 monthly ~= $Xk (placeholder) — ravi please add a proper cost calc in the PR and include on-call cost ops for burst scenarios. Tag resources for automated chargeback.

ravi: Will open PR with Terraform module + vars by EOD. PR will include validation steps and smoke tests: 1) VPC up + subnets, 2) NAT per AZ, 3) KMS key present, 4) IAM roles created, 5) quota increase approved, 6) test AMI boots with GPU drivers and nvidia-smi ok, 7) model fetch from regional S3, 8) peering routes visible.

lia: I'll open the quota support case now and CC @morgan @ravi. Also confirm if we want reserved instances or Savings Plan for the H100s — finance needs recommendation.

morgan: favours reserved capacity for predictability but finance wants a 6–12 month comparison. Ravi include both reserved and on-demand cost scenarios in PR.

ravi: noted. Also adding a small canary runbook: provision 1 node in private-a, run inference container pulling model from regional S3, run 1000 small inferences to verify latency and kernel setup. If pass -> scale to 8.

morgan: awesome. After PR merged, ops will run handoff and create the confluence runbook entry. Ping me for canary window. :thumbsup:

helen: tagging this thread into #incidents for visibility in case quotas block the timeline.

jack: one more network gotcha — ensure TGW route propagation timing in eu-west-3; last time propagation lagged and caused intermittent control plane issues during bootstrap. Add wait-for-route step in terraform.

ravi: will include `depends_on` + explicit route propagation check in TF and a small retry loop in the smoke test.

morgan: thanks all — assigning to @ravi for infra PR and @lia for quota escalation. We'll reconvene here after PR is up.
